items.name: chartonly4
items.prompt: Create ONE image that is a clean 2x2 grid of FOUR separate, equal-sized vertical 9:16 photographs separated by thin plain white gutters. All four panels are small variations of the SAME composition. Base it on the attached image: the same unrolled antique parchment sea-chart scroll on a dark background, same border, compass roses, depth ruler with tick marks only, empty specimen-label frame, red wax seal and the engraved line-art sailing ship. REMOVE the blue cube model completely — there must be NO 3D object, NO cube, NO box, NO ocean cross-section and NO shadow of an object on the paper. Fill the place where the cube was with the chart itself: engraved sepia ink wave lines across the open sea, gentle depth-contour rings drawn WITHOUT any numbers, and coastlines continuing naturally. LAYOUT RULE: the upper 35% of the parchment must stay clean, EMPTY blank paper (only the border line) — reserved for handwriting added later. ABSOLUTELY NO letters, words, numbers, labels or pseudo-writing anywhere. Old natural-history encyclopedia plate style, warm dim lighting, photographed flat and straight-on, shallow depth of field at the very edges only. No people, no hands, no logos, no watermark.
